title: Microsoft Agent 365: registry sync from external AI platforms
summary: Hold the briefing because its licensing explanation relies on superseded service-description columns. The current table identifies Connected Platforms as a core capability included with a Microsoft cloud subscription, while the connection paths, opt-in default and roadmap targets remain supported.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes discovering externally created agents and automatically syncing them into the Agent 365 registry for visibility and governance.
claims.quote: Connect to external AI platforms to discover agents created outside Microsoft and automatically sync them into the Agent 365 registry for more complete agent visibility and governance.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Synchronization is manually started by an administrator using Sync agents.
claims.quote: After you save the connection, select Sync agents to start synchronization. You need to manually synchronize the agents.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Agent 365 does not currently synchronize connected platforms on a schedule.
claims.quote: Manual synchronization only. Agent 365 doesn't currently sync on a schedule, and Microsoft doesn't prescribe a fixed synchronization interval.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Removing an agent from the source platform is not guaranteed to remove its registry entry automatically.
claims.quote: Synchronization doesn't currently guarantee that an agent removed from the source platform is automatically removed from the Microsoft 365 agent registry.

claims.claim: The general guide says to select Sync agents after saving a connection.
claims.quote: After you save the connection, select Sync agents to start synchronization.

claims.claim: Saving a Databricks Genie connection starts its first synchronization.
claims.quote: When you save the connection, the details pane opens and starts the first synchronization.

claims.claim: Later Databricks Genie synchronizations use Sync agents.
claims.quote: To synchronize after you create or share more Genie agents, open the connection and select Sync agents.

claims.claim: Registry sync provides visibility and governance for agents administrators do not build or host themselves.
claims.quote: It provides visibility and governance for agents you don't build or host yourself.

claims.claim: Registry sync does not add code-level capabilities.
claims.quote: Registry sync doesn't add code-level capabilities.

claims.claim: Learn documents a usable Connected platforms feature despite the roadmap's In development status.
claims.quote: Use the Connected platforms page to connect supported third-party agent platforms to Microsoft Agent 365.

claims.claim: The integration-options page labels registry sync as preview.
claims.quote: | Registry sync (preview) | Connected agent platforms, such as Google Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock. | Configured per platform. Imports agents for visibility and governance. | No |

claims.claim: Registry coverage depends on the connected platform and does not guarantee every source agent is included.
claims.quote: Coverage depends on the connected platform and the agents it exposes, so a registry entry represents the supported information available from that source - not a guarantee that every agent on the platform is included.

claims.claim: Synced agents appear in a common inventory with other agents.
claims.quote: Agent 365 can synchronize supported agents from connected platforms into the Microsoft 365 agent registry, where they appear with other agents in the organization's inventory.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Registry sync is admin-opt-in: no agents sync without an administrator configuring a connection.
claims.quote: The Agent 365 AI administrator creates and manages the connection in the Microsoft 365 admin center. After you create a connection, Agent 365 can discover supported agents and add them to the Microsoft 365 agent registry.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Connection credentials are stored as encrypted connection data within Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: Agent 365 stores the credentials that you enter for a connection as encrypted connection data within Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: Every currently supported platform requires a key-based credential.
claims.quote: Every currently supported platform requires a key-based credential, such as an API key, secret, or private key.

claims.claim: Connected platforms does not currently support workload identity federation or role assumption.
claims.quote: Keyless authentication options, such as workload identity federation or role assumption, aren't currently supported for Connected platforms.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Collect agent observability data is enabled by default for new connections.
claims.quote: New connections have this setting enabled by default.

claims.claim: Observability collection retrieves agent activity telemetry using the connection's stored credentials.
claims.quote: When you enable this setting, Microsoft 365 retrieves agent activity telemetry—such as agent sessions, usage, and related operational signals—from the connected platform by using the connection's stored credentials.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Telemetry retrieval can incur source-provider data access or query charges.
claims.quote: Retrieving agent telemetry from the connected platform might query the provider's own logging or data services (for example, Google BigQuery or Amazon S3) and can incur data access or query charges that the provider bills.

claims.claim: Connected platform connections are read-only by design.
claims.quote: Connected platform connections are read-only by design:

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Agent 365 does not invoke or interact with source agents.
claims.quote: Agent 365 never invokes, executes, or interacts with agents in the source platform.

claims.claim: Agent 365 does not write to the source platform except when an administrator explicitly removes a synchronized agent.
claims.quote: Agent 365 doesn't write to, modify, or delete resources in the source platform. The only exception is an explicit administrator action to remove a synchronized agent

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The general guide describes source deletion as requiring a separate optional delete permission.
claims.quote: The only exception is an explicit administrator action to remove a synchronized agent, which requires a separate, optional delete permission that you can choose not to grant.

claims.claim: The Google Vertex AI guide includes aiplatform.reasoningEngines.delete in the permissions to grant.
claims.quote:
Grant the service account the Vertex AI permissions required for agent discovery and management:
aiplatform.reasoningEngines.list
aiplatform.reasoningEngines.get
aiplatform.reasoningEngines.delete

claims.claim: Databricks Genie activity collection requires Can Manage permission.
claims.quote: Activity requires Can Manage. Databricks returns the conversations of all users of a Genie agent only to principals that have Can Manage permission.

claims.claim: Can Manage also permits moving a Genie agent to the trash when an administrator removes it in Agent 365.
claims.quote: | Can Manage | Also read the agent's sharing details, collect conversation activity from all users of the agent, and move the agent to the trash when an administrator removes it in Agent 365. |

claims.claim: Agent 365 uses a fixed set of outbound IP addresses for source-platform APIs.
claims.quote: Agent 365 calls source platform APIs from a fixed set of outbound IP addresses.

claims.claim: Source-network restrictions can cause authentication errors even with correct credentials.
claims.quote: When a network restriction blocks Agent 365, the connection can fail with the message Authentication failed. Please check your credentials and try again., even when the credentials are correct.

claims.claim: The documentation describes no autonomous synchronization or source-agent execution by registry sync.
claims.quote: Searched: Agent 365 registry sync rollout schedule; opened Connected platforms, Databricks Genie and integration-options guides. They document manual sync, an initial sync on saving Databricks, and no source-agent invocation.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The connection-creation path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All Agents > Connected platforms > Manage > + Connect a platform.
claims.quote: Open the Microsoft 365 admin center. In the navigation pane, select Agents > All Agents. In the Connected platforms web part, select Manage. Select + Connect a platform.

claims.claim: The observability-setting path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All Agents > Connected platforms > Manage > connection > Edit > Collect agent observability data.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Agents > All Agents. In the Connected platforms web part, select Manage. Open the Connected platforms page in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Create a new connection, or select an existing connection and edit it. Select or clear Collect agent observability data.

claims.claim: No administrative API is documented for connected-platform connection management or running Sync agents.

claims.claim: No administrative API is documented for Collect agent observability data on a connected-platform connection.

claims.claim: Clearing Collect agent observability data stops new collection for that connection's agents.

claims.claim: Telemetry collected earlier is retained according to existing retention and management behavior.
claims.quote: The agent registry retains telemetry collected earlier according to its existing retention and management behavior.

claims.quote: When you need to rotate credentials, change the source scope, revoke access, or remove the connection, follow the relevant provider guide.
